description: Read the organization subscription capacity, reserved and pending consumption, replenishment status, and snapshot freshness. For an agency-managed organization, the response describes its attributed subscription consumption. Requires 'account-read' scope.
name: check_balance

billing_mode.description: Subscription capacity routing mode; native_setup_required indicates setup is pending

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

money_display.description: Formatted subscription capacity amounts with currency labels, ready to display without further conversion. Unavailable amounts are omitted; zero amounts are included.

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

title: Check Subscription Capacity
